title: EXCEPT keeps the duplicates of a row that is only in the left table

source.quote: If a row appears in only tableExpression1, it and its duplicates will appear in the result set.
source.supports: the page shows these two tables and this result for Except(States2, States1)

derivation: Left is now B, C, D, D, D, E, E, E. Only E is absent from the other table, and its three copies stay.
